responsibility: Defines the ABI-stable C++ side of the gccrs-to-Polonius foreign-function interface. It introduces the primitive Polonius atom types and FFI-friendly container/layout types such as Pair, Triple, Slice, and FactsView, and lays out the raw frozen fact relations—loan issuance, CFG edges, subset facts, variable/path events, and placeholders—that are passed across the language boundary without depending on C++ standard-library tuple abstractions.
